answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on two benchmark non-collaborative tasks: the price negotiation task... and the charity persuasion task...
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses (utterances) in negotiation and persuasion settings

answer_2.quote: We consider three commonly used metrics: Success Rate (SR), Average Turn (AT) and Sale-to-List Ratio (SL%).

answer_3.quote: we prompt LLMs to judge the conversation progress at each turn and transform it into scalar rewards. Specifically, in the negotiation task, we employ a separate GPT3.5 (OpenAI, 2022) to assess whether both parties have reached a deal.
methods: post‑generation binary deal assessment via prompting

answer_4.quote: We conduct interactive human evaluation using the LegoEval platform with crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk... we hire 20 crowdworkers... collect 50 dialogues for each agent...
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers converse with agents on negotiation and persuasion tasks and rate the dialogues according to task success and overall quality.
